# Loop: go to previous song until we find a liked one
max_steps = 100
for _ in range(max_steps):
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    song_id = current['song_id']
    priv = apis.spotify.show_song_privates(song_id=song_id, access_token=access_token)
    if priv['liked']:
        print(f"Reached liked song: {song_id}")
        break
    # go to previous song
    result = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Moved to previous song: {result}")
else:
    print("No liked song found within 100 steps")
